en:
Captain, the resupply went
well. It seems Reimi and the
others had a good time blowing
off some steam while shopping.
Reimi's Voice: Wow, it looks so\ngood on you! It was totally\nworth splurging!
It's quite lively. Did they pick\nup something special?

I wondered what they were
buying, but those clothes look
expensive. Are you sure you
should be dressing me in them
first?

They'll look best on you, Nel! I'll
wear mine later, and then we'll
call everyone else over for a
dress-up party!
She's energetic... Well, I'll\nhonestly thank you for thinking\nthey'd suit me.
Oh my! How glamorous! They\nlook quite old; are they some\nkind of antiques?

Yeah, they're relics from a race
that once flourished here.
They're said to be incredibly
valuable, both historically and
artistically.

I see, ancient ethnic clothing.
They're lovely, possessing a
primitive strength alongside a
progressive delicacy... or
something like that.
Yes, yes! They are truly\nexquisite. By the way, about\nhow much were they?
So expensive...!?

Yeah, they were so expensive
that we could only afford one
for a man and one for a
woman.

Y-You bought two of them at
that price~!? Where on earth
did you get the budget for
that~!?

...What is it? I thought the ship
was getting noisy, and here
you are getting worked up over
something trivial again.
Oh, Albel! Perfect timing! I have\na set of men's clothing here, so\nwould you please try it on?
Hmph. I'd rather be sleeping\nthan indulging in such\nnonsense.
Oh... He brushed me off\ncompletely. And I thought it\nwould look so good on him.

He has no sense of
cooperation... Even if he's going
to refuse, he could at least be
a bit more polite about it.

Hmm... Come to think of it, did
the people of Planet Augus
make these clothes? I heard
about them during resupply
too.

Yes, it's the fallen Planet
Augus. I heard its inhabitants
perished, leaving only ruins and
a few relics on this desolate
world.

The environment is terrible,
and the ruins where the local
gods were enshrined are so
dangerous that even grave
robbers avoid them now...

Apparently, some strange
scholar is meddling with those
dangerous ruins on that
desolate planet, and the space
merchants are worried.

I wanted to keep an eye out if
this ship passed by... So this is
where these clothes were
made.

Augus was on the star charts
you bought. Since we're
passing through the area now,
shall we go take a look?

Hmm... This planet is in a
terrible state. It's on the
absolute brink of being unable
to support life... It's right on
the edge.

There are traces of a small
craft having landed very
recently. Perhaps it belongs to
that scholar?

Hmm... But for such a desolate
planet, what is this strange
energy? Moreover, it's
amplifying...!
What do you mean by that!?

N-now that you mention it, the
god of Augus was a raging
deity of calamity... It is said
that any careless contact
would bring disaster.

Once provoked, it would cause
calamities until the god was
satisfied, leaving the planet
more desolate with every
occurrence...

Some even say these
traditional clothes were
originally worn by dancers to
appease the gods...

...The scholar is a young man
eager for glory, and he was
reportedly trying to investigate
that very god of Augus.
That is definitely the pattern of\nsomeone provoking something\nthat should never be disturbed!

Ugh, this is not good. If left as
it is, this energy is at a level
that could strip the entire
surface of the planet away.
For everyone's safety, I believe\nwe should withdraw\nimmediately...

Even on a planet where the
inhabitants have perished, I
believe the traces of their
culture should be protected!

Moreover, we can't let a
scholar from an advanced
planet let a superior ancient
culture vanish through their
own selfishness!

Yes. It would be painful to
simply pass by when we are
here. We may very well have
the power to stop this.

I wouldn't expect that from
Albel, but Reimi and Nel would
definitely say that. That's what
makes you two so wonderful.

Well, even by Federation moral
standards, we can't just ignore
this. Shall we resolve the
situation, Captain? Preparing
for landing!

The air is... barely breathable.
But I have a terrible feeling.
Like a storm is about to break
at any moment...!

This sensation is too abnormal.
We must hurry. No time to
change, but everyone, we must
protect the scholar's traces...!
Gishaaaaaa!

What?! What are these things?!
This environment shouldn't be
able to support any surviving
indigenous life!

Are these creatures from the
Demon World? Don't tell me
the god of this place is from
the Demon World...!

Understood! I'll issue a request
for cooperation to everyone on
board as an emergency
situation!!
If we don't hold them here, the\nship will be in danger.\nEveryone, let's move!

Phew... we managed to repel
them. There were so many. If
the whole crew hadn't fought
together, we would have been
overwhelmed.
You're right, it was truly thanks\nto everyone's cooperation!
...Or so I thought, but it seems\nAlbel-san was the only one\nresting in his room...

I can't believe he could sleep
through an emergency like this.
There's a limit to being
uncooperative.

I-I'm sure he was just
exhausted! He seemed to be
leading the charge in the last
battle, too.
Come to think of it, I feel kind\nof tired... Ugh... so... tired...
A-Are you okay, Reimi-san?\nYou look much worse than just\nbeing tired!

...Wait, everyone else looks
strange too!? A-And my body...
my movements are slowing
down...!
*Cough*...!
Reimi! What on earth\nhappened?! Everyone else is...\nsuddenly collapsing...!

This planet's air must contain
something harmful that
sensors and our senses can't
detect...! *Cough, cough*...!

All crew... no, even those with
mechanical bodies like Coro,
please evacuate to the ship
immediately! Before you end up
like me!
Ugh... ah...
Reimi, hang in there! I'll carry\nyou, so stay strong!

*Cough*... I'll be fine. My body
adapts quickly to
environments. I'll recover soon,
so please, Nel, evacuate
yourself...!
Dammit... I can't just leave\nReimi when she's in this much\npain...
What? Why am I the only one\nwho's okay...? N-now that you\nmention it, why am I safe?
Even Coro, who's made of\nmachinery, is being affected...

It's likely because of those
traditional clothes. Traditional
garments are optimized for
survival in that specific land.
*Cough*... They must provide\nresistance to these harmful\ncomponents... *Cough, cough*...!

I see, if those clothes work,
then Reimi can too...! Come on,
Reimi, I know it's hard, but put
this on...

You mustn't take them off!
You're the only one who can
still move properly, Nel! *Cough,
cough*...!
...No, there's one more. There\nmight be one more person who\nescaped the effects...!
...I've seen enough. You\nmeddling little pests.

This is what happens when you
play the hero and stick your
nose into the affairs of a dying
planet.

It's a stroke of luck you were
sleeping through the
emergency request. Anyway,
help everyone evacuate.

You lot chose to land on this
dangerous planet of your own
free will. Make them walk back
on their own two feet.

If the captains fall, we'll perish
with this planet. If you don't
want to die, shut up, put this
uniform on, and get to work.
...Tch, why do I even have to\nwear this outfit...?

Phew... Is everyone safe on
board? It seems even after
escaping the outside air, they
won't be able to move for a
while.

I just brought Reimi inside, but
she hasn't recovered yet. The
others will likely take even
longer.
We might need to escape this\nplanet... but we can't operate\nthe ship ourselves.

Are we just waiting for this
divine curse to subside? Those
kind-hearted fools will start
dying any moment now.

I know that without you telling
me. If it's come to this, we
have no choice but to cut off
the source!
We'll find that strange scholar\nand put an end to this!
...*Pant*... *pant*... No sign of\nthe scholar here either...

You're slow. Aquaria's greatest
infiltrator shouldn't be dawdling
like this. Are you slacking off in
a situation like this?

My training is different from a
combat maniac like you.
Besides, this planet's surface
is far too desolate to just walk
across...

Don't make excuses, pest.
You're just undertrained. No
matter the situation, if you
can't move, you're nothing but
dead weight.

So the Aquaria army is run by
such weaklings? I should've
just launched a full-scale
assault and crushed them all
at once.

If you have enough energy left
to curse, then you must be
feeling reliable. It looks like our
destination is close.

There are traces of recent
activity in that cave over
there. That must be the temple
ruins.

I see, no wonder I can sense
enemies. There's a significant
number of them waiting. Get
ready, Nel!

Phew... We fought our way
deep into this cave. From the
looks of it... this area used to
be a residential district.

There must have been grand
buildings here, but most have
returned to the earth. This
planet's environment must
have been truly harsh.

It seems the inhabitants of this
planet were a sturdy people
with horns like these
decorations, but life must have
been difficult nonetheless.

On a desolate planet like this,
being sturdy doesn't amount to
much. It's only natural they
went extinct.

No people deserve to go
extinct. Especially those
capable of creating such
exquisite art as these clothes...
it's tragic that they're gone.

Hmph, wasting energy on art is
why they lost. If they'd just
crushed the gods and nature
with sheer force, they might
still be alive.

If you lose and perish, leaving
clothes behind won't matter.
No matter what... the one who
survives in the end is the
winner.

If we lose, it's over. I agree. We
carry the lives of everyone on
this ship, so we can't afford to
lose either.
So... the rest... is up to you...
...What's wrong? Stop messing\naround. Get up. Get up and\nkeep moving.

Sorry, but standing up looks
difficult. It seems even the
protection of these clothes has
its limits.

You never know when it might
happen to you. There's no time!
Find the scholar and stop
him―a young man in black
robes and a black hat.
Do you intend to just rot away\nhere?
Don't make me say it.
Hmph... Interesting.
Whoa, what? S-stop, Albel!\nWhat do you think you're\ndoing...?!
Shut up, you idiot, you'll alert\nthe enemy. Just... let me carry\nyou.

...What are you doing? If you're
trying to make me indebted, I
refuse. Just leave me behind;
I'll only be a burden.

Are you mocking me? I told
you my training is different.
Carrying a woman won't make
me a burden.

Besides, it's not for your sake.
If I press these two pieces
together, the effect might be
stronger and last longer.
Pr-pressing them together?!\nDon't say such ridiculous\nthings! Let go! Let... me... go!

What, do you have enough
energy to make that much
noise? It seems it worked. In
that case, we're moving on.

Unlike you, I won't rot away on
this planet. I'll heal those fools
quickly and put an end to this
nuisance.

For that purpose, I'll even carry
you, even if you were once
part of the enemy army. That's
all.

...Alright. Sorry for the scene.
We're doing this to save
everyone, so please, let me
lean on you for a while.

These footprints are
particularly fresh. They lead
that way. Yes, get into that
collapsed area over there.

The collapse looks fresh, and
there's still dust in the air... It
seems the source of this
trouble is indeed nearby.
Hm, a man in black...! So that's\nthe so-called scholar.
It looks that way... But he's just\nstanding there, doing nothing?\nSomething is definitely wrong...
And besides, why is he\nperfectly fine without any\ntraditional clothing?
Scholar in Black: ...O.
...OOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!
Damn it, wh-what is that?! Can\nyou see it, Nel?!
I see it! Something glowing that\nappeared above the scholar...!

Is it linked to the scholar...? Is
it possessing him?! Don't tell
me that's the god of this
planet?
...OOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!
Ahh! The cave, it's cracking...!
*Cough*... *Wheeze*! What is\nthis... I suddenly can't\nbreathe...!

Is that god spreading the toxic
air on this planet...? If so, if we
can just stop its activity... if we
can calm it down...!

But how...? Reimi said we have
to wait until the god's wrath
subsides... but what can we
do?!
...Looks like we don't have time\nto think. That thing, it found us!
...OOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!
...Ooooh...
Huh? That thing suddenly went\nquiet.
Black-Robed Scholar: Ugh...
Hm, the scholar collapsed. Has\nthe god... vanished as well?

What, did that so-called god
just run out of steam? Well, it
did go on a rampage against
us for a while.
Heh... Or maybe he lost\nconsciousness because I gave\nthat annoying scholar a kick?
You were doing that? ...Well, I\nmight have snuck in a few hits\nmyself.

Good grief. I was prepared for
a life-or-death struggle with a
god, but it ended before things
even got interesting.
As if it could ever be\n"interesting." Honestly...

Still, this scholar has caused
everyone so much trouble. We
must restrain him and hand
him over to the proper
authorities.
Oh? It looks like you're feeling\nbetter now that he's gone.
Come to think of it... Has the\nharmful air dissipated now that\nthe god has been calmed?
I see... In that case, those fools\nshould be on the mend as well.

What's this? You're more
worried about the Captain and
the others than I thought.
Weren't they just a "nuisance"
to you?

Who'd worry about idiots who
went looking for trouble on
their own?! This stupid job is
finally over!
And I don't need this flashy,\nrestrictive outfit anymore\neither!

W-Wait, are you taking that off
here?! You didn't even bring a
change of clothes! Stop
exposing more skin than
necessary!!
Huh? Whether you're bothered\nor not is none of my damn\nbusiness!
A-Anyway, stop stripping here!\nWait until we get back to your\nroom on the ship!
Tsk, you're so damn noisy. Fine,\nlet's just get back then.

I'll carry that scholar. But if
they collapse on the way like
they did when we arrived, I'm
leaving them behind!
Yeah, yeah, I know!

This story has concluded. We
plan to release various other
stories in the future. Please
look forward to them.
Ha! Yah!!
...Weren't you just collapsed a\nmoment ago? You seem quite\nenergetic.

I'm still a little wobbly, to be
honest. Besides, I felt bad
staying in that crowded
infirmary.

In that case, just rest in your
room. Are you really that eager
to play with that "Fight
Simulator" thing?
...Fayt Simulator? Not "Fight"\nSimulator?
...What are you talking about? I\nsaid "Fight." I didn't mistake it\nfor your name.

You did. You said "Fayt." Did I
worry you enough for my name
to slip out? Or do you want to
simulate me?
Like I'd want to! Fine, just go\nplay with your "Fight Simulator"\nall you want!

Hahaha, I'm not going to play
something that uses this much
stamina right after being sick.
But...

This whole thing made me
realize something. Just how
immature I am, for falling so
easily...
It was likely just a disaster. All\nof you collapsed together like a\ngroup.
That's not quite true.

While I lay helpless, the
Captain, Cliff, and even Maria
gritted their teeth to provide
medical aid to everyone.
I felt so pathetic, unable to\nmove even a finger.
That's why I didn't come to the\n"Fight Simulator" to play today.
I came to the "Battle Simulator"\nto retrain my spirit.

Hmph. From my view, everyone
on this ship is just a bunch of
good-natured fools sticking
their noses into everything
without considering their limits.

Hehe, in that case, you're one
of those good-natured fools
too, since you're the one who
helped us.
I have heard the details of\nwhat happened. My apologies\nfor causing you trouble, Albel.
Dammit, who's a fool? I only\nact for myself. If you lot stay\ndown, this ship won't move!

Cyuss and Arumat are able to
move again too. That's a relief.
But, what are you two doing
here?

Same as you. It would be a
disgrace to the name of the
Reaper to be taken down by
something like this.
I gotta get moving to make up\nfor all that time I spent\nknocked out, or I'll get soft.
What the―! You two were\nlistening to what I was just\nsaying!?
Yeah, we heard every word!

Phew... Since you caught me,
you two are joining in. Albel
too! Don't think I'll go easy on
you just because you're
recovering...
Ugh...
Hey!!
You okay, Fayt?! Shouldn't you\nbe resting a bit longer?
Sorry for worrying you. I just\nfelt a little dizzy, but I'm fine\nnow.
Put this on.
Eh?

Apparently, this clothing repels
the harmful substances that
caused you to collapse. It
should speed up your recovery,
too.
...Um, you mean the thing\nyou're wearing right now,\nAlbel? I think... I'll pass on that.
Huh? You planning on being a\npatient forever?
No, I mean, of course I want to\nget better as soon as possible,\nbut still...

That outfit is so exposed, it's
practically naked. We're not at
the beach; I can't go around
dressed like that.

Hm? It's true the waist and
sleeves are a bit cluttered, but
the upper body is relatively
comfortable.

You might be used to seeing
your stomach and thighs on
display, Albel, but... isn't it
embarrassing?
Hmm, is it embarrassing? Being\nshirtless?
Hmph. I don't care. I don't\nwaste my time worrying about\nhow others dress.
Fayt, what are you trying to\nsay? What's wrong with this\noutfit?

Ugh, I can't handle these
three... If I walked around the
ship dressed like that, I'd
definitely be a laughingstock.
A laughingstock, you say...?\nWHAT IS WRONG WITH MY\nOUTFIT!!
That's just saying people would\nlaugh if they weren't used to it!

Dammit, I was going to go easy
on you since you were just
collapsed a moment ago, but
I'm not playing around!

Put these clothes on now! And
recover immediately!! Once
you're better, I'm going to tear
you apart!!
Whoa, stop! Don't pick on a\nrecovering patient! Don't strip\nme! Stop it~~!
That was quite an ordeal... But\nI am just glad to see everyone\nhas recovered safely.

Now then, as originally planned,
let's have a fashion show with
the Augus traditional clothing!
Shall we?
I knew it... I'm the one who has\nto wear it first...
As expected of Lady Nel! It\nlooks wonderful on you!

Hawawa, how cool! Lady Nel's
charm is enough to slay both
men and women! It'll kill them in
one hit!

I see, so these are the Augus
dancer's garments that soothe
the God of Calamity. And they
certainly did.

So the reason he calmed down
was because we fought while
wearing this... I can't be sure of
that now, though.

Hehe... With the clothes and
the wearer being this beautiful,
everyone will be so mesmerized
they'll forget all their anger.

Hmm? These patterns look like
Glyph Arts. Maybe they
developed independently? It's
interesting, but... I don't really
get it.

Yeah! Setting the difficult stuff
aside, the design is lovely! It's
got such a cool, mature
sexiness!

Aside from the dyeing, the
structure doesn't look too
hard. I might be able to make
something with a similar shape!

Let's see, if the fabric goes like
this and the lining like that... I
really want to try it on to be
sure. Hey, can I try it on next?

Hey, no fair, Miki! I want to try
it on soon, too! I wonder how
the construction around the
sash works?
H-hey, stop pulling! You're\ngoing to make it fall open. I'm\nnot wearing much underneath!
It's okay! I'm already wearing\nsomething underneath! See?\nJust like this!
Oh dear, if that's the case... I'm\nglad I brought that outfit.
*Sigh*... I can't deal with Millie\nand the others. Maybe I'll step\nout until things calm down.
But Clair. Why on earth did you\nbring that outfit...?

You mentioned a fashion show,
so I thought I'd bring it along to
see if I could find someone to
model it.
But as it turns out, you might\nbe the one who carries it best,\nNel.

Yes, Lady Nel is the best! I
could never pull off that outfit,
or even the last one, nearly as
beautifully as you~!

Ah, but wait! If we're talking
about what suits Lady Nel,
then that Fallen Angel outfit
was even better!
Oh, that was lovely too. It\nsuited you perfectly...!

If we were to dress Nel in
something else... Oh, I think a
bridal gown would suit her
perfectly.

A bridal gown! That would
surely be wonderful. I'd love to
try wearing one myself, just
once...

Then just wear one. Welch
used to make "bridal gowns"
called power suits, so why
don't you ask her?
No way, not something from\nWelch!
If Welch-san made it, it would\ndefinitely come with some\nweird functions attached.
(But that's the best part...)

Besides, her style is a bit too
provocative. I can only imagine
the clothes she'd make if she
just let her imagination run
wild...

Ah, I'd love to see Nel-sama or
Clair-sama walking the stage in
those clothes while I gaze up
at them!

Stop it. Stop even imagining it.
I don't know what you're
picturing, but I hope they aren't
terribly revealing.

It's fine. In terms of skin
exposure, I don't think it would
be much different from what
you're wearing now.
Why are you comparing them\nso specifically? Clair, what\nexactly are you seeing...?

I heard there was a fashion
show and I've arrived a little
late! Are you all having fun,
meow?
Oh, Nel! Clair! You've already\nchanged! You look wonderful!

Ah, yeah. Your outfit is nice
too, Sophia. The ribbons look
like Meracle and the others'
ears; it's very cute.

Thank you! It's my favorite
because it's so cute! You look
wonderful too, Nel, like a cool,
mature woman!
Such cute clothes... Hey, since\nthis is a fashion show, why\ndon't you two swap outfits?
Oh, that's a great idea! I'd love\nto see Nel looking cute!

It's true that sexy looks better
on you, Nel. In that case, I have
some clothes I borrowed from
Maria!
Let me see, let me see! Oh...\nthese have rabbit ears? I love\nit!

Those are the clothes from the
casino infiltration! They're
wonderful! I want to dress
Nel-sama and Clair-sama in
them and watch them roll on
the floor!
Th-that's enough! Why is\neveryone trying to dress me\nup?
Farleen, Tynave! If you want it\nthat badly, I'll dress you two up\nfirst! Clair, you too!
Oh my, it looks like things are\nheating up over there. I'm glad.

Well then, with the costumes
everyone brought along, shall
we begin the second act of our
fashion show!
